$comment: Mirrors app.api.intel_schemas.CveRecordRequest. CVE intel is not a confirmed finding — finding record stays gated on exploit-developer validation.
title: Intel CVE Record — version-matched or disclosed vulnerability on a target component. NOT a finding; use finding record only after exploit-developer confirms exploitability.

affected_component.description: Product/library name the CVE applies to, ideally matching an intel_tech_components.component.

cvss_score.description: CVSS base score 0.0–10.0 from the authoritative source; null if not published.

cwe_id.description: CWE identifier for the root-cause weakness (e.g., 'CWE-79', 'CWE-89').

poc_available.description: Whether a public proof-of-concept exploit exists.

source_name.description: Tool or feed that surfaced this CVE (e.g., 'nvd', 'nuclei', 'osint-analyst', 'exploitdb').

validation_status.description: Exploitation validation state. Use: 'unverified'=just recorded; 'version_match'=target version is in affected range (not yet probed); 'poc_available_unverified'=public PoC exists but not yet run against target; 'attempted_blocked'=exploit attempt was blocked by WAF/IPS (set details.block_reason); 'exploited'=confirmed exploitable — link finding via linked_finding_slug; 'ruled_out'=patched, misconfigured, or otherwise not exploitable on this target.

linked_finding_slug.description: assessment_findings.slug to populate once exploit-developer confirms exploitability (status='exploited').

notes.description: Operator analysis: patch evidence, version mismatch reasoning, environment constraints, or next-step dispatch context.

block_reason.description: Required when validation_status='attempted_blocked' — names the WAF/IPS/runtime block that prevented validation.

agent_name.description: Specialist agent role that recorded this row (e.g., 'osint-analyst').

artifact_ref.description: vigil artifact ID or path that contains the raw evidence.

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this row was written.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source that supports this record.
